categories.main_business_segments: ResMed operates in two primary business segments: Sleep and Breathing Health, which includes medical devices and solutions for sleep apnea, COPD, and other respiratory disorders; and Residential Care Software, which provides cloud-based software solutions for healthcare providers in residential care settings such as home medical equipment, home health, hospice, and senior living facilities.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies include cloud-connected CPAP, APAP, bilevel, and ventilation devices, as well as diagnostic tools and patient engagement applications. Manufacturing is globally distributed, with facilities in the US, Australia, Singapore, Malaysia, China, and France, focusing on technical assembly, quality control, and continuous process improvement. ResMed also develops and integrates AI and machine learning algorithms into its devices and software platforms to enhance therapy performance and user experience.
categories.primary_customers_markets: ResMed’s primary customers are home medical equipment (HME) providers, sleep clinics, hospitals, and healthcare professionals treating sleep and respiratory disorders. The company also serves residential care providers, including home health, hospice, skilled nursing, and senior living organizations, through its software segment. End markets include patients with sleep apnea, COPD, neuromuscular disease, and other chronic respiratory conditions, as well as healthcare professionals managing care in home and residential settings.
categories.geographic_coverage: ResMed sells products in over 140 countries, with significant operations in the United States, Canada, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Australia. The company has wholly owned subsidiaries and manufacturing sites in key regions, including the US, Australia, Singapore, Malaysia, China, and France. Residential Care Software is primarily sold in the US and Germany.
categories.supply_chain_position: ResMed operates primarily in the downstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and distribution of finished medical devices and software solutions directly to healthcare providers and end users. The company also provides vertically integrated home healthcare services in select countries and manages a global supply chain for components and finished goods.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: ResMed’s strategic priorities include expanding its core sleep apnea portfolio with AI-driven, connected devices, increasing awareness and diagnosis of sleep and respiratory conditions, and investing in digital health ecosystems for home-based care. The company is committed to ongoing innovation in both devices and software, supporting clinical trials globally, and leveraging real-world data from its large installed base to inform product development and improve patient outcomes.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through the sale of medical devices (CPAP, APAP, ventilators), masks, accessories, and diagnostic products, as well as through recurring revenue from cloud-based software subscriptions and services for residential care providers. Additional revenue streams include extended warranties, patient engagement platforms, and, following the VirtuOx acquisition, diagnostic testing services billed to payors.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors in the Sleep and Breathing Health segment include Philips BV, Fisher & Paykel Healthcare, DeVilbiss Healthcare, Apex Medical, BMC Medical, React Health, Jiangsu Yuyue Medical, and Lowenstein Medical, as well as regional and new entrants. In Residential Care Software, competition is intense and includes both commercial vendors and in-house solutions. ResMed is positioned as a global leader in digital health and cloud-connected respiratory care, with a strong brand and broad product portfolio.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ended June 30, 2025, ResMed reported net revenue of $5.15 billion, up 10% from the prior year, with net income of $1.4 billion and a gross margin of 59.4%. The company has over $8.2 billion in total assets and employs approximately 10,600 people worldwide. ResMed has demonstrated consistent revenue and profit growth, supported by strong operating cash flow and ongoing investment in R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: ResMed differentiates itself through its integrated ecosystem of cloud-connected devices, AI-driven digital health solutions, and comprehensive software platforms that enable efficient, personalized, and home-based care. The company emphasizes improved patient outcomes, enhanced provider efficiency, and reduced healthcare costs, leveraging its large installed base, real-world data, and continuous innovation to deliver superior comfort, compliance, and interoperability across care settings.
